records.subject: Welcome to Wrenfield, Pioneer Ventures!
records.body:
Hi Ines,

Welcome aboard! Wrenfield is built for teams, so it gets more useful once at least one other person is in it -- a teammate can be invited from Account Settings -> Members at any time.

Happy to help if you hit a wall.

Thanks,
Chidi Haddad

decisions.rationale: 6 days in, no project, no invite, no milestone (stall_reasons). Only contact was a bug report (tick_1a684141ed2c) and no customer replies to welcome [email:1c3c3e77] or resolution [email:adf70d3a]; Starter, single admin. Low unaided odds of first project + milestone in 8 days.

draft.subject: Getting Pioneer Ventures started in Wrenfield
draft.body:
Hi Ines,

Thanks for flagging the mobile save button issue last week -- Tariq let you know it's resolved, and that ticket is closed now, so do say the word if it shows up again.

Since then I haven't wanted to leave you stuck on the setup side. In Wrenfield, projects are the main organizing unit and tasks live inside them, and the in-app onboarding flow walks through creating a first project. If it's easier, I'm glad to walk through that first project with you on a short call this week -- just reply with a time that suits.

Best,
Chidi
